title: Boston Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with South Shore Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Commission APPROVES the 365-Day Transportation Agreement between Boston Gas Company and South Shore Hospital. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
